o.text: Borrowed from Russian анса́мбль (ansámblʹ), ultimately from French ensemble.
From Persian مناره (menâre), from Arabic مَنَارَة (manāra).
Izafet II compound of söz + birləşmə. Calque of Russian словосочета́ние (slovosočetánije)
